# IB BioNinja

> > Comprehensive IB Biology study resource covering molecular biology, cellular processes, genetics, physiology, and ecology aligned to IB curriculum standards.

IB BioNinja provides detailed explanations of International Baccalaureate Biology topics for both Standard Level (SL) and Higher Level (HL) students. Content is organized by IB curriculum codes (B1.1.1, C3.1.1, etc.) and covers core biological concepts from molecular mechanisms to ecosystem conservation.

## Key Topics

- ATP and adenosine triphosphate
- DNA and RNA synthesis
- Krebs cycle and cellular respiration
- Central nervous system (CNS) and peripheral nervous system (PNS)
- Membrane transport and aquaporins
- NADH and electron transport
- Insulin and hormonal regulation
- Aerobic and anaerobic respiration
- Organic compounds and carbon chemistry
- Nerve signalling and myelin
- Osmoregulation and homeostasis
- IB curriculum standards (B1.1.1, C3.1.1-C3.1.5, D21, A42)
- Protein synthesis and translation
- Mitochondrial structure and function

## Molecular Biology & Biochemistry

- [Organic Molecules](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/organic-molecules): Carbon chemistry of carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids & proteins (B1.1.1)
- [Organic Compounds](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/organic-compounds): Carbon macromolecules with condensation & hydrolysis reactions (B1.1.1-3)
- [Transcription](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/transcription): RNA synthesis from DNA template via RNA polymerase & base pairing
- [Translation (HL)](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/translation-hl): Protein synthesis & folding of insulin, collagen, haemoglobin (HL)

## Cellular Respiration & Energy

- [Cell Respiration](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/cell-respiration): ATP energy production via aerobic & anaerobic respiration pathways
- [Mitochondrion](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/mitochondrion): Mitochondrial structure with Krebs cycle & electron transport chain
- [Krebs Cycle](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/krebs-cycle): Citric acid cycle with acetyl CoA oxidation in mitochondria

## Cell Structure & Transport

- [B21 Membranes and Membrane Transport](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/b21-membranes-and-membrane-transport): Membrane structure & transport via diffusion, osmosis, & active transport
- [Facilitated Diffusion](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/facilitated-diffusion): Passive membrane transport via channel & carrier proteins
- [D21 Cell and Nuclear Division](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/d21-cell-and-nuclear-division): Mitosis, meiosis & cell cycle with DNA replication & cytokinesis

## Nervous & Endocrine Systems

- [Integration](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/integration): Nervous & endocrine system integration with reflex arcs (C3.1.1-C3.1.5)
- [Communication](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/communication): CNS/PNS nervous & endocrine signalling with hypothalamus integration
- [Nerve Signalling](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/nerve-signalling): CNS/PNS neuron signalling with Schwann cells & myelin sheath

## Homeostasis & Physiology

- [Negative Feedback](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/homeostasis): Homeostasis via negative feedback with ADH, insulin & glucagon regulation
- [Excretory System](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/excretory-system): Kidney nephron function with glomerulus, loop of Henle & osmoregulation (HL)

## Genetics & Evolution

- [Dihybrid Cross](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/dihybrid-crosses): Genetics inheritance using Punnett grids & FOIL method
- [Species](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/species): Biological species concept with hybrid & ring species classification
- [A42 Conservation of Biodiversity](http://ib.bioninja.com.au/a42-conservation-of-biodiversity): Species extinction & biodiversity loss with anthropogenic causes
